chunks: About the muhrim: may he wear a garment that perfume has touched? He said, "If the scent of the perfume has gone, then let him wear it."

key_terms.الْمُحْرِمِ: a person in the state of ihram

ai.seo_question: Can a muhrim wear a garment that had perfume on it if the scent is gone?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning clothing in the state of ihram. It indicates that a muhrim may wear a garment previously affected by perfume once the scent of the perfume has disappeared.
